title: Patient Account Terms of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Tiers
content:
Patient Financial Services applies the following account terms to the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, tier by tier: interest-free payment plans, small-balance write-offs, financial-hardship waivers and credit-balance refunds.

## Payment plan terms

| Tier | Longest payment plan, in monthly installments | Payment plan minimum balance | Payment plan minimum installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 0 (payment plans not offered) | 150.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 6 | 150.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 6 | 150.00 USD | 25.00 USD |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 10 | 100.00 USD | 20.00 USD |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 10 | 100.00 USD | 20.00 USD |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 0 (payment plans not offered) | 100.00 USD | 20.00 USD |

The minimum balance is the smallest patient balance for which an interest-free payment plan may be requested; the minimum installment is the smallest monthly installment accepted on a plan; a longest-plan figure of 0 means payment plans are not offered on the tier.

## Write-off, hardship and refund terms

| Tier | Small-balance write-off ceiling | Hardship waiver allowed | Hardship income ceiling (percent of the HHS poverty guideline) | Credit-balance refund limit (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 0.00 USD (no write-off) | No | 200 | 30 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 4.99 USD | Yes | 200 | 30 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 4.99 USD | Yes | 200 | 30 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 4.99 USD | Yes | 200 | 60 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 0.00 USD (no write-off) | Yes | 200 | 60 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 0.00 USD (no write-off) | No | 200 | 60 |

- The **write-off ceiling** is the largest remaining patient balance written off as a small balance instead of being statemented; 0.00 means no small-balance write-off on the tier.
- **Hardship waiver allowed** states whether a documented financial-hardship waiver of patient cost share may be granted case by case on the tier; the **income ceiling** is the household income limit for that waiver, as a whole percent of the current HHS federal poverty guideline for the household size.
- The **refund limit** is the time for refunding a customer credit balance (overpayment), counted in calendar days from the posting date of the entry that created the credit.

## Reading across the tiers

- Payment plans are offered on four tiers: up to 6 installments on the two commercial tiers and up to 10 on the two Medicare tiers.
- The CGM Medicaid Program has a 200 percent income figure on file, but its hardship waiver is not allowed, so that figure has no waiver to govern on the tier.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical tier whose longest plan is 4 installments, whose minimum balance is 80.00 USD and whose minimum installment is 15.00 USD, a balance of 70.00 USD is below the minimum balance and qualifies for no plan, while a balance of 80.00 USD meets the minimum balance.
